name: Jigoku no Oishasan
source:
You wake up in an unfamiliar hospital room, your memories gone.
Why are you here? Why can't you remember anything?

A strange doctor is about to find out.

[From [url=https://skrmtr.itch.io/hells-doctor]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在陌生的病房里醒来，失去了全部记忆。
你为什么会在这里？又为什么什么都想不起来？

一位古怪的医生，马上就要替你查个水落石出了。

[摘自[url=https://skrmtr.itch.io/hells-doctor]itch.io[/url]]
